standing: Full in-repository execution authorization granted by the project owner on 2026-10-19 and reiterated on 2026-10-20. Destructive Git/filesystem actions, package changes, broad project-settings changes, and external publishing still follow recorded approval gates.
approvals.policy: Required for destructive operations, installs, dependency changes, broad project settings, major architecture changes, external publishing, and unclear/consequential actions.

risks: Unity Personal offline license validity expires periodically; it required a Unity Hub refresh on 2026-10-19 and may block batch automation again.
The Unity project has scenes, player/room prefabs, and test suites, but no gameplay loop, customers, machines, economy, or save system exists yet.
No dedicated image, 3D, audio, or voice-generation tool is verified.
The project now uses Linear color space; future lit materials and lighting must be authored and checked for that space.
Asset production may require licensed external sources and approval.
Placeholder signage uses the built-in LegacyRuntime font and simple cube panels; it is not final typography or branding.
The secret-door concealment is a static placeholder shelf/panel; human review must judge whether it is too obvious or too subtle, and future reveal logic must animate or remove it.
Scene/prefab merge conflicts are a high-risk collaboration surface.
Global OpenCode configuration uses a local Ollama default; this project overrides it with the verified free DeepSeek model.
Free-model spend telemetry is not reliable; limits are conservative and process-based.
technicalDebt: Test coverage is limited to 10 EditMode and 11 PlayMode tests; no gameplay, save, or performance coverage yet.
No Git LFS patterns configured for future large assets.
Project settings were edited as serialized YAML before an editor settings API existed; re-verified by batch reopen.

assets.note: Procedural placeholders only: 3 scenes, 2 prefabs, and 11 materials. Verified counts room and player; production art/audio remain absent.
